vt1019073.title: Olympus OM-10 QD Black 35mm SLR Film Camera Body with Data Back Meter LED Issue
vt1019073.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1019073.details: Olympus OM-10 QD black 35mm SLR film camera body with a Data Back. Condition: signs of use and small scratches from age, but fairly clean overall; the film chamber and the battery compartment are clean. Checked by the previous owner: auto mode (the shutter speed changes with the brightness), the self-timer, film winding and rewinding all work. Known issues: the exposure meter LED in the viewfinder does not light when the shutter button is half-pressed and lights only when the shutter is released, and the Data Back shows its display but the date imprint function was not checked, so it may not work. There is dust in the viewfinder but the view is clear. The camera has not been test-shot with film, so please treat it as an as-is item. Included: the camera body with the Data Back only; no lens, battery or film. Please see the photos for the exact condition.
vt1019073.why: A used Olympus OM-10 QD film SLR body with a Data Back and a meter LED issue.
vt1019073.perfect: Film photographers and OM system fans who accept the meter LED issue.
vt1019073.exp: A pre-owned Olympus OM-10 QD body in the condition and with the issues described above.
vt1019073.cd: Pre-owned with signs of use and small scratches. Auto mode, self-timer, film winding and rewinding work. The meter LED in the viewfinder does not light at half-press and lights only when the shutter fires. The Data Back display shows but its date imprint function was not checked. Dust in the viewfinder.
